messages.subject: A favor
messages.body:
Support asked me for a ticket number. I found it, but now they say there’s no incident in the public archive.

The original message for 8C2F passed through relay-07. Can you retrieve it? I’d like something I can send back to Support.

— Mira

messages.subject: The missing notice
messages.body:
The incident names my registration number on notice 2917. I checked my inbox again. It never arrived.

The relay handed it to postbox-03. Could you recover it from the hold? I’d like to know who was trying to reach me.

— Mira
